title: Formulating Ternary Inclusion Complex of Sorafenib Tosylate Using beta-Cyclodextrin and Hydrophilic Polymers: Physicochemical Characterization and In Vitro Assessment.
authors: Donthi, Mahipal Reddy; Munnangi, Siva Ram; Krishna, Kowthavarapu Venkata; Marathe, Sandhya Amol; Saha, Ranendra Narayan; Singhvi, Gautam; Dubey, Sunil Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究索拉非尼与环糊精及聚合物的三元包合物制备与表征，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-环糊精，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sorafenib tosylate (SFNT) is the first-line drug for hepatocellular carcinoma. It exhibits poor solubility leading to low oral bioavailability subsequently requiring intake of large quantities of drug to exhibit desired efficacy. The present investigation was aimed at enhancing the solubility and dissolution rate of SFNT using complexation method. The binary inclusion complex was prepared with beta-cyclodextrin (beta-CD). The molecular docking studies confirmed the hosting of SFNT into hydrophobic cavity of beta-CD, while the phase solubility studies revealed the stoichiometry of complexation with a stability constant of 735.8 M(-1). The ternary complex was prepared by combining the SFNT-beta-CD complex with PEG-6000 and HPMC polymers. The results from ATR-IR studies revealed no interaction between drug and excipients. The decreased intensities in ATR-IR peaks and changes in chemical shifts from NMR of SFNT in complexes indicate the possibility of SFNT hosting into the hydrophobic cavity of beta-CD. The disappearance of SFNT peak in DSC and XRD studies revealed the amorphization upon complexation. The ternary complexes exhibited improved in vitro solubility (17.54 microg/mL) compared to pure SFNT (0.19 microg/mL) and binary inclusion complex (1.52 microg/mL). The dissolution profile of ternary inclusion complex in 0.1 N HCl was significantly higher compared to binary inclusion complex and pure drug. In cytotoxicity studies, the ternary inclusion complex has shown remarkable effect than the binary inclusion complex and pure drug on HepG2 cell lines.
abstract_zh: 甲苯磺酸索拉非尼（SFNT）是肝细胞癌的一线治疗药物。其溶解度较差，导致口服生物利用度低，因此需要摄入大量药物才能达到预期疗效。本研究旨在通过包合方法提高SFNT的溶解度和溶出速率。采用β-环糊精（beta-CD）制备二元包合物。分子对接研究证实SFNT被包合进beta-CD的疏水空腔中，而相溶解度研究揭示了包合作用的化学计量比，其稳定常数为735.8 M(-1)。通过将SFNT-beta-CD包合物与PEG-6000和HPMC聚合物结合制备三元包合物。ATR-IR研究结果显示药物与辅料之间无相互作用。包合物中SFNT的ATR-IR峰强度降低及NMR化学位移变化表明SFNT可能被包合进beta-CD的疏水空腔中。DSC和XRD研究中SFNT峰的消失揭示了包合后的无定形化。三元包合物相较于纯SFNT（0.19微克/毫升）和二元包合物（1.52微克/毫升），其体外溶解度（17.54微克/毫升）有所提高。在0.1 N HCl中，三元包合物的溶出曲线显著高于二元包合物和纯药物。在细胞毒性研究中，三元包合物对HepG2细胞系表现出比二元包合物和纯药物更显著的效果。
